products.name: Brisk Teaching
products.note: AI: Browser extension for feedback, quizzes, reading level changes and lesson materials inside Google Docs, Slides and YouTube. Who: Teachers; students through teacher-guided activities. Student age: Under 13 only with school consent under COPPA, or parent consent outside school. Privacy: Student Data Privacy Pledge signatory; states FERPA and COPPA compliance; Student Data Privacy Addendum and state data privacy agreements; 1EdTech TrustEd Apps certified. profile_text.body:
Brisk describes itself as an AI platform for teachers and students, offering tools to build lessons, personalize learning, and plan what to teach next. According to its site, Brisk brings AI into the tools teachers already use, covering planning, feedback, and student support across the teaching and learning cycle. The company says it earned a 95% Common Sense Privacy Rating, which it describes as one of the highest among AI tools built for education.

The company's tracked product is Brisk Teaching, a browser extension for feedback, quizzes, reading level changes, and lesson materials inside Google Docs, Slides, and YouTube. Its users are teachers and, through teacher-guided activities, students. For students under 13, use requires school consent under COPPA or parent consent outside school. Brisk is a Student Data Privacy Pledge signatory, states that it complies with FERPA and COPPA, offers a Student Data Privacy Addendum and state data privacy agreements, and is certified under 1EdTech TrustEd Apps. A free plan is available for teachers, while school and district plans are priced per student on request.

The available record contains no litigation, no MCP servers, and no SEC or patent facts for Brisk.
